name: Arishima Kaoru
source:
Part-time teacher at Shuuhei high school. Ancient literature teacher, forty-five year old, married.

He just lets time roll off his back, watching as his life runs by without doing much with it.

[Edited from [url=https://laplacian.jp/yonagi/en]Laplacian[/url]]
